summary_scope_note: Plain-text substantive summary of the immediately preceding assistant message; presentation markup and file-link rendering omitted.

40_fold.recommendation: Including the HR=1 reference permits approximately 40-fold; this is a plausible contextual reading, not proof that a range restricted to the Aplus stages equals 40.
40_fold.basis: The citing sentence explicitly names the A−T2− reference; 39.9/1=39.9, while 39.9/1.5 excludes that reference.
40_fold.limitation: This supports the reference-relative reading, not a claim that every possible definition of range equals 40.

author_stage_mapping.recommendation: The author-intended coarse analogy is understandable, but the source neocortical group is not established as equivalent to the citing scheme’s combined C/D group.
author_stage_mapping.basis: Citing Table4 requires both medial-temporal and neocortical tau positivity for C and D. Source methods s9c and published page8 report that only 49/65 in the baseline neocortical group were also MTL-positive; the source grouping does not impose the same full conjunction. The source temporal-neocortical ROI and positivity grouping also do not independently validate the citing moderate/high C/D subdivision.
author_stage_mapping.baseline_count_caveat: 49/65 describes the full baseline neocortical group, not a separate tally of the 60-participant clinical-progression subset; no subset-specific count is inferred.
author_stage_mapping.limitation: In our scheme means the stage names are the citing authors’ own. Absence of identical names is not itself an error, but numeric HR=39.9 cannot automatically be treated as a validated estimate for the exact combined C/D population or separately for each stage.

research_design.recommendation: The verification principle is correct: inspect actual pooled analyses rather than keyword presence. This audit does not establish that the study satisfies a strict meta-analysis definition.
research_design.observed_methods: Seven cohorts, N=1325, participant-level Cox models adjusted for age, sex, education and cohort, plus longitudinal mixed-effects models.
research_design.guidance_paraphrase: IPD meta-analysis can use a one-stage regression accounting for study grouping; absence of a two-stage pooling step alone does not disprove meta-analysis.
research_design.limitation: Cochrane guidance illustrates methods, not certification of this observational study as a systematic IPD review. Strict study-design naming remains open.
